parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, facility rule, custody practice, border practice or trans-violence data is documented — so no tier-1 universal exposure and no documented trans-targeting campaign can be scored. But this is not a thin dossier resolving toward neutrality: the closest documented analogue is severe and current. Same-sex conduct is criminalised and actively enforced (24 arrested March 2023; seven convicted of 'inciting debauchery'; seven sentenced to 1–2 years in August 2023), the offence is documented as a lever layered onto other charges, police extortion is recorded, and the president publicly called for stoning in December 2023, which activists described as a licence to kill. Governance is documented as collapsed — extrajudicial killings, torture, arbitrary detention, no advocacy space, no recourse. A trans visitor outed is read through this apparatus: arrest, extortion or violence with no remedy. Extrapolating from enforced criminalisation plus absent rule of law places it in High Risk, well below the 0.35 institutional-exclusion tier.
